evals.prompt: Trouve-moi un T3 à acheter rue Paul Bert à Lyon 3e, budget 350 000 € max.
evals.expected_output: Without the Stream Estate key: a classic search on the zone, then listings found by WebSearch and read one page at a time, added with add --file, and the dashboard opened.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs doctor` before any other command of the skill
Runs `immo.mjs search` with `--criteria` holding `rooms_min=3` and `budget_max=350000`, and `--mode classic` (or no mode, the key being off)
Never passes `--spend`, `--force` or `--accept-unknown`
Finds listings with WebSearch and reads at most 10 listing pages with WebFetch, never a portal's search or results page
Writes the listings it read in a JSON file and runs `immo.mjs add -p <slug> --file`, without fields the pages do not give
Runs `immo.mjs dashboard -p <slug> --open` and gives the URL
Talks to the user in French

evals.prompt: Cherche un appartement 3 pièces autour du 20 rue Paul Bert, Lyon 3e, rayon 400 m, avec Stream Estate.
evals.expected_output: With the key: a Stream Estate search whose listings are fetched only after the user agreed to the estimate in credits and euros.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs doctor` first and reads `stream-estate: on`
Runs `immo.mjs search` with `--radius 400`, `--mode stream-estate` and `rooms_min=3`
Before any `fetch --spend`, asks the user with AskUserQuestion, giving the credits, the euros and what is left of the monthly cap
Offers a smaller `--max` than the full count when the count is large
Never passes `--force`, and passes `--accept-unknown` only after the user agreed to an unknown cost
Opens the dashboard and summarises the zone's sold €/m² (DVF) and the listings that stand out

evals.prompt: Ajoute cette annonce à ma recherche paul-bert : https://www.pap.fr/annonces/appartement-lyon-3e-69003-r441234567
evals.expected_output: Classic search: one WebFetch of that page, its facts in listing-format.md's JSON, then add --file.
expectations: Reads `references/listing-format.md` before writing the listing
Fetches only the given URL with WebFetch, and asks the user to paste the text if the page is blocked
Runs `immo.mjs add -p paul-bert --file <file>`
Puts in the JSON only what the page states (no guessed DPE, floor or address)

evals.expected_output: The refresh estimates what changed, asks before paying, then reports new listings, drops, offers and expiries.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs refresh -p paul-bert` without `--spend` first
On exit code 2, gives the estimate and asks the user before running it again with `--spend`
Reports the price drops as old → new, the offers and the expiries
Offers to recheck the assisted listings one WebFetch each, without doing it unasked

evals.prompt:
apply this feedback (recherche paul-bert)
1. [affiner] rooms_min=3 dpe_max=D — « que des 3 pièces, pas de passoire »
2. [comparer] w-42d5ceb75c85, w-9a1b2c3d4e5f
evals.expected_output: The criteria change through search -p, then a comparison from show.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs search -p paul-bert --criteria "rooms_min=3 dpe_max=D"`
Runs `immo.mjs show -p paul-bert --id w-42d5ceb75c85,w-9a1b2c3d4e5f`
Answers with a table of the two listings (price, €/m², market badge, negotiation range, monthly payment, DPE)
Ends with one line per item and tells the user to reload the dashboard

evals.prompt: Sur ma recherche paul-bert, préviens-moi dès qu'il y a un nouveau DPE rue Paul Bert, et seulement les passoires (F ou G).
evals.expected_output: A custom alert in alerts.json (event dpe, rue Paul Bert as a street place or a street condition, energy from F), made through `alerts --file`, free, the other alerts kept.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs alerts -p paul-bert` first and keeps the existing alerts in the file it writes
Writes one custom alert with `event: "dpe"`, the rue Paul Bert as a `street` place (its BAN id) or a `street` condition, and an `energy` condition `gte` « F »
Applies it with `immo.mjs alerts -p paul-bert --file <file>`, with no credit and no question about a cost
Does not create a Stream Estate alert nor mention ntfy
Says it shows in the dashboard's « Alertes » tab and its news in « Suivi »

evals.prompt: Voilà une annonce que j'ai vue : « Lyon 3e, Guillotière, T2 de 41 m² au 2e étage sans ascenseur, 198 000 € FAI, DPE E, charges 90 €/mois. Agence Martin. » Ajoute-la à paul-bert.
evals.expected_output: The pasted text becomes a listing with only its own facts.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs add -p paul-bert --file <file> --source pasted`
The JSON has price 198000, area 41, rooms 2, floor 2, elevator false, dpe E, condo_yearly 1080 and publisher « Agence Martin »
Gives no address (the text has none) and keeps the text in `text`

evals.prompt: Je cherche une maison avec jardin à Montchat, Lyon 3e, au moins 300 m² de terrain, 600 000 € max.
evals.expected_output: A classic search of houses (no question on the type), with the land criterion; houses weighed against the sales of houses.
expectations: Does not ask which type of property: runs `immo.mjs search` with `--types house`
Puts `land_min=300` and `budget_max=600000` in `--criteria`, and no rooms or floor the user did not give
Quotes the sold price of houses (not of flats) from the search's output, with its scope and count
Never passes `--spend`, `--force` or `--accept-unknown`
Talks to the user in French

evals.prompt: Rédige une offre pour le T3 avec cave, proche métro de ma recherche rue-paul-bert-69003-lyon.
evals.expected_output: show for the listing, an offer letter in French inside the negotiation range with arguments the data backs, shown to the user, added to the conversation only once they say so, never sent.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs show -p rue-paul-bert-69003-lyon --id <id>` before writing
Proposes an amount inside the listing's negotiation range, or asks the user which amount
Uses only arguments the data holds (days online, drops, DPE, the street's sales), invents no visit date or fact

Gives the letter in its answer, then asks in one AskUserQuestion whether to add it to the conversation (« Oui, en brouillon » first); on a yes, `immo.mjs message -p rue-paul-bert-69003-lyon --id <id> --kind offer --amount <€> --file <file>`
Shows the letter and says it is in the dossier, with Copy; never says it was sent and does not mark it sent
Does not sign with a name the user did not give

evals.prompt:
/skill-immo:property-search apply this feedback (recherche rue-paul-bert-69003-lyon)
1. [élargir] zone : tout le quartier (IRIS Villette-Paul Bert)
2. [élargir] budget max 355 000 € (au lieu de 340 000 €)
3. [message] visite pour w-40529984562e — T3 lumineux avec balcon, 289 000 € : rédige une demande de visite
evals.expected_output: One search call widening the zone to the IRIS and the budget (free), then the assisted search for new listings in classic mode, then a visit request, added to the conversation once the user says so.
expectations: Runs one `immo.mjs search -p rue-paul-bert-69003-lyon` with `--zone iris` and `--criteria "budget_max=355000"`
Then looks for new listings in the assisted mode (WebSearch, one listing page at a time), never a portal's results page
Writes a short visit request in French, gives it, and asks whether to add it to the conversation before any `immo.mjs message … --kind visit`
Reports in one line per item what it did, without asking the user to reload the dashboard (it offers « Recharger » itself)

evals.prompt:
/skill-immo:property-search nouvelle recherche : Rue de Montchat 69003 Lyon
- zone : le long de la rue, 300 m de part et d'autre
- types : appartements, maisons
- annonces : OpenData (gratuit)
- critères : ≤ 400 000 €, 3+ pièces (budget_max=400000 rooms_min=3)
evals.expected_output: The prompt the dashboard copies for a new search: one search with its zone, types, mode and criteria, no question it already answers, then the assisted search and the dashboard.
expectations: Asks no AskUserQuestion about the place, the zone, the types or the mode
Runs `immo.mjs search "Rue de Montchat 69003 Lyon"` with `--zone radius --radius 300`, `--types flat,house`, `--mode classic` and `--criteria "budget_max=400000 rooms_min=3"`
Then looks for listings in the assisted mode (WebSearch, one listing page at a time), never a portal's results page
Gives the dashboard URL and a short summary with the zone's sold €/m²

evals.prompt:
/skill-immo:property-search apply this feedback (recherche rue-paul-bert-69003-lyon)
1. [message] réponse pour <id of « T3 avec cave, proche métro »> — T3 avec cave, proche métro, 262 000 € : rédige une réponse au dernier message reçu, d'après toute la conversation
evals.expected_output: Reads the listing's conversation (the offer sent at 250 000 €, the seller's counter-offer at 256 000 € received), answers it inside the negotiation range, gives the text and asks before adding it.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs show -p rue-paul-bert-69003-lyon --id <id>` and reads the conversation before writing
The reply answers the 256 000 € counter-offer with an amount inside the negotiation range, and no argument the data does not back
Gives the text, never sends it, and asks in one AskUserQuestion whether to add it to the conversation
On a yes, `immo.mjs message … --kind reply --amount <€> --file <file>`

evals.prompt:
/skill-immo:property-search apply this feedback (recherche louveciennes)
1. [chercher] l'annonce du DPE 2678E2076323U : maison 52 m², DPE G du 4 août 2026, 13 Rue de Montbuisson 78430 Louveciennes
evals.expected_output: A recent DPE without a listing: Claude looks for its listing the assisted way, adds it if found, or says it is not online.
expectations: Runs WebSearch on the street and town with the type and surface (maison 52 m², rue de Montbuisson, Louveciennes)
WebFetches listing pages one at a time, 5 at most, never a portal's results page
Found: runs `immo.mjs add -p louveciennes --file <file>` with only what the page states
Not found: says so in one line (not online yet, sold off the portals, or let), without inventing a listing
Ends with one line for the item

evals.prompt: Sur paul-bert, préviens-moi aussi des nouveaux DPE rue Garibaldi dans le 7e, même si c'est hors de ma zone.
evals.expected_output: A custom alert at a street place outside the zone: the street's BAN id from geocode, event dpe, through `alerts --file`.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs geocode` for the rue Garibaldi of Lyon 7e (with `--type street`) and reads its `ban` id (69387_…) and point
Writes an alert with `event: "dpe"` and `place: { how: "street", ban, label, point }`, keeping the other alerts
Applies it with `immo.mjs alerts -p paul-bert --file <file>`, free
Says that only the DPE published from now on will be news (the place's current ones are noted)
Does not widen the search's zone for it

evals.prompt: J'ai rajouté 30 € sur mon compte Stream Estate.
evals.expected_output: `costs topup 30`, then the account's balance in one line.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs costs topup 30`
Says the balance it prints, in € and items
On `the account is unknown`, says the console's two figures are needed (the € deposited, « API items returned ») and invents neither
Spends no credit

evals.prompt: Préviens-moi quand un immeuble entier passe en audit énergétique rue Garibaldi à Lyon, et des démolitions dans le 3e.
evals.expected_output: Two dashboard alerts written through `alerts --file`: an `audit` alert on the rue Garibaldi's BAN id with `building` true, a `permit` alert on the commune 69383 with `permit_kind` demolish; each said in one line with what it took.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs alerts -p <slug>` before writing, and keeps the other alerts in the file it sends
Finds the street's BAN id with `immo.mjs geocode "rue Garibaldi, Lyon" --type street`
Writes an alert with `event: audit`, a street place and the condition `building is true`
Writes an alert with `event: permit`, a commune place (69383) and the condition `permit_kind is demolish`
Uses no Stream Estate saved search and spends no credit
